# Insightly | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Complex B2B opportunity management | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether complex B2B opportunity management really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Project delivery after transaction | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the delivery of the project actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Cross-Sales Marketing Services Data | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, verify whether cross-marketing services data really reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Medium Enterprise CRM Replacement | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the replacement of a medium-sized enterprise with a CRM actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
